```
Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, wherein the non-native compartment further comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides from different bacterial species.

Claim 10 (Currently Amended): The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides that are specifically engineered for use in the non-native compartment.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes the at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product.

Claim 21 (Currently Amended): A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product, wherein the substrate is metabolized into a bioactive product; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product.
```
